configuration.assumptions: Diagnostic source-proportioned linkage with ideal hinges/slider, two 1 kg balls, inferred light links and sleeve, gravity at 0.1 m per world unit, and only spindle position actuation. No valve load, feedback engine or bevel contact yet. Speed endpoints optionally include the full linkage gravity and rotational-inertia derivatives; the native transient remains passive.
